notes.title: Version 1.3.1
notes.content:
* Fixed a problem with the background music when turning it on and off in the house.
* Fixed some other small bugs.

notes.title: Version 1.3
notes.content:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33892579/7cf3fcdd449274cb4c227a37776c62afd695fbb8.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33892579/9a4f06629b07131d40d561d27204df59efdb4fd3.png[/img][/url]

* Added a new area to explore.
* Added another way to escape.
* More items to use.
* The player now has a smoother crouching animation and moves faster when crouching.
* Changed some textures and some other stuff.
* Fixed some bugs.

notes.title: New update v. 1.2.1
notes.content:
* Added a new Game Over end.
* Added a little Christmas feeling
* Fixed some bugs

notes.title: Version 1.2
notes.content:
* Bigger house to explore.
* Granny has a "new" rusty car.
* New pet
* Now another way to defend yourself from Granny.
* Fixed some small bugs.
